# pylimer-tools

> pylimer-tools is a Python and C++ toolkit for simulating, analyzing, and handling bead-spring polymer networks and LAMMPS molecular dynamics output (Monte Carlo network generation, DPD simulations with slip-springs, implicit Rouse and Brownian dynamics, Maximum Entropy Homogenization / Force Balance, normal mode analysis, and topological resistance distance & network structure analysis).


2021-2026, Tim Bernhard

## Pages in this subsection

- [do_linear_walk_chain_from_to](pylimer_tools_cpp.do_linear_walk_chain_from_to.html.md): Get coordinates linearly interpolated from one point to another (both exclusive).
- [do_random_walk](pylimer_tools_cpp.do_random_walk.html.md): Do a random walk, return the coordinates of each point visited.
- [do_random_walk_chain_from_to](pylimer_tools_cpp.do_random_walk_chain_from_to.html.md): Do a random walk from one point to another.
- [do_random_walk_chain_from_to_mc](pylimer_tools_cpp.do_random_walk_chain_from_to_mc.html.md): Do a random walk from one point to another.
- [inverse_langevin](pylimer_tools_cpp.inverse_langevin.html.md): A somewhat accurate (for $x &#92;in (-1, 1)$) implementation of the inverse Langevin function.
- [peel_topological_leaves](pylimer_tools_cpp.peel_topological_leaves.html.md): Peel 1-core dangling trees and subgraphs iteratively from the CrosslinkerUniverse topology.
